nodes.title: Global river plastic inputs — Lebreton et al. (2017)
nodes.description: A global model of plastic inputs from rivers into the ocean, published by Lebreton et al. in 2017. This static release preserves the 40,760 river input locations and all 53 numeric attributes in the original Figshare v6 shapefile. Estimates represent the 2010 model baseline; they are not current measurements. This is distinct from the later Meijer et al. 2021 model.
